newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman starts Barrett as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Lehman starts Barrett as buy.

text.p: -- Lehman analyst James Whipkey started coverage of Barrett Resources Corp with a buy rating.
-- In a research report, Whipkey said he estimated 1996 earnings per share at $0.88, and 1997 at $1.63.
-- He said the company has a "pristine balance sheet and a stellar record of production growth and reserve replacement efficiency."
-- "We believe Barret's strategic entry in the offshore Gulf of Mexico will provide new cash flow growth starting in late 1997 and through the end of the decade," he said.
